title: ControllerLeft
description: Server to host: the place in this slot has no connected controller, and why (ADR 0005 section 10, amended 2026-11-14). `disconnected`: the controller's connection closed and its token is still valid. `session_ended`: its token ended with its site session. `dropped`: the host dropped it. `free`: only in the replay after each host welcome, for a place that holds no token. `via` is present with every reason but `free`, and absent with `free`.

slot.description: The controller's place, 1 or 2, given by the server.

via.description: How the controller got its token. Absent with `free`.

reason.description: Why the place has no connected controller.
